data.body_html:
Choosing between the Astondoa 40, Azimut 39 and Pershing 46 for your Marbella 2030 charter? All three depart from Puerto Banús, but they serve very different moods. This direct comparison covers capacity, speed, pricing and the kind of day each boat delivers – so you can pick the right one without guesswork.

If you’re still exploring options, browse our full [fleet](/).

Astondoa 40 – The Flybridge Cruiser

The Astondoa 40 is a 12.5-metre flybridge motor yacht that carries up to 9 passengers. Its upper helm station gives you 360° views of the Marbella coastline – ideal for spotting La Concha from the sea or watching the sunset over the Strait of Gibraltar. Top speed is around 28 knots, comfortable cruising at 20–22 knots.

  • Length: 12.5 m
  • Capacity: 9 pax
  • Departs: Puerto Banús
  • Pricing: Tier A – from €749/2h to €2,299/8h (all inclusive)

Best for: couples or small groups who want a relaxed, panoramic cruise with a touch of elegance.

Azimut 39 – The Social Sport Cruiser

Also 12.5 metres long, the Azimut 39 is a sport cruiser with a notably spacious cockpit and seating for 11 passengers – the highest capacity among these three. Its open stern layout makes it easy to move around, sunbathe on the foredeck, or jump into the water at Cala del Faro. Cruising speed is similar to the Astondoa 40: 20–25 knots.

  • Length: 12.5 m
  • Capacity: 11 pax
  • Departs: Puerto Banús
  • Pricing: Tier A – from €749/2h to €2,299/8h (all inclusive)

Best for: groups of friends, birthday parties or family outings where sociability matters most.

Pershing 46 – The Performance Open Yacht

The Pershing 46 is a 14-metre open sport yacht built for speed. With twin diesel engines pushing over 45 knots top speed, it’s the fastest boat in this comparison. It carries 10 passengers and has a sleek, aggressive profile that turns heads in Puerto Banús. The open layout is minimalistic – focused on driving and the sea.

  • Length: 14 m
  • Capacity: 10 pax
  • Departs: Puerto Banús
  • Pricing: On request via WhatsApp (custom quote)

Best for: thrill-seekers, bachelor parties or anyone who wants to cover distance fast – Marbella to Estepona in under 20 minutes.

Which One Should You Choose?

If you want views and comfort – the Astondoa 40’s flybridge is unmatched for sunset cruises along the Golden Mile. If you’re bringing a bigger group – the Azimut 39 seats 11 and has the most sociable deck layout. If you want speed – the Pershing 46 is in a different league; reach Sotogrande in 30 minutes.

All three include a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks and snacks – so you don’t need to worry about anything except enjoying the day. For Tier A pricing on the Astondoa and Azimut, you can book directly online. For the Pershing 46, [contact us via WhatsApp] for a custom quote.
